name: @craftos/agent-app-pi
description: Agent App Framework plugin for Pi (earendil-works/pi): the /agent-app launcher command, the six framework skills, and an extension that makes Pi reachable from `agent-app <dir> bridge`. Pi drives the agent-app and a2app CLIs with its own bash tool.
//pi: A Pi package manifest (packages.md). `prompts` ships the /agent-app launcher; `skills` is a copy of the single source of truth at the repo root (../../skills), made by `build` and again on pack, because Pi resolves manifest paths inside the package and a published tarball holds nothing outside it; `extensions` registers Pi's headless route for the app→agent bridge. See README.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('skills',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('../../skills','skills',{recursive:true});process.stdout.write('pi plugin: copied ../../skills into ./skills; pi loads the extension as TypeScript\n')"
